capabilities: Render node-stream diagrams from code blocks in several formats
Display ComfyUI-exported workflow JSON files placed in the vault
Describe diagrams with a lightweight list syntax modeled on mermaid/plantuml
Render Obsidian canvas file contents as node streams
Run functional workflow nodes for text, web requests, and AI text tasks
extras: README warns the plugin is undergoing a major refactor and the next stable release is delayed; detailed tutorials, online demos, and use cases live on external documentation sites rather than in the README; README is bilingual (English/Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no way to render node-stream diagrams from tools like ComfyUI, Blender, or UE, or to describe such graphs with lightweight text syntax.

relations.evidence: nodeflow-comfyui prefix, using the workflow json exported by comfyui software as content
indicating that this is a reference mermaid/plantuml, using light text to describe the chart format
available in both Obsidian and VuePress blogs

summary: Node-based diagram renderer that displays ComfyUI-style node streams in notes via code blocks, JSON files, or a lightweight list syntax.
